title: Env.float misparses scientific notation
author: jakezwang
body_preview: `Env.float()` removes the exponent marker and positive exponent sign before parsing, so valid scientific notation can silently produce the wrong value.  Reproduced on `develop` at `9c1fc30b2b2330f297187904190c3baf80919876`, Python 3.14.7 on macOS:  ```python from environ import Env  env = Env() env.ENVIRON = {"VALUE": "1e3"} print(env.float("VALUE"))  # 13.0; expected 1000.0  env.ENVIRON["VALUE"]...
